description:
**Original Webtoon:**  
[Peanutoon](https://www.peanutoon.com/ko/comic/detail/8227), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/4451003149), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=10391710), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000060232), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/camera_monopoly)

Ji-eun, who takes pictures because she wants to own what she loves forever, gets caught by his friend Ju-min while secretly taking pictures of Min-hyuk, her crush. Ju-min, who is a popular playboy and has a lot of money, is hurt by Ji-eun's words that she loves her friend and not him, and makes an offer under the condition that he not report her... "From now on, only me will be on your camera."

The forced gaze begins to show more and more sincerity.
